1.web: Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,
1.asv: Jehovah, remember for David All his affliction;

2.web: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
2.asv: How he sware unto Jehovah, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

3.web: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;
3.asv: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, Nor go up into my bed;

4.web: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids;
4.asv: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Or slumber to mine eyelids;

5.web: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
5.asv: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, A tabernacle for the Mighty One of Jacob.

6.web: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar:
6.asv: Lo, we heard of it in Ephrathah: We found it in the field of the wood.

7.web: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.
7.asv: We will go into his tabernacles; We will worship at his footstool.

8.web: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place; you, and the ark of your strength.
8.asv: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.

9.web: Let your priest be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!”
9.asv: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let thy saints shout for joy.

10.web: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
10.asv: For thy servant David’s sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.

11.web: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
11.asv: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

12.web: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”
12.asv: If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.

13.web: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
13.asv: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.

14.web: “This is my resting place forever. Here I will live, for I have desired it.
14.asv: This is my resting-place for ever: Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

15.web: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
15.asv: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

16.web: Her priests I will also clothe with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
16.asv: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

17.web: There I will make the horn of David to bud. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
17.asv: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

18.web: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will be resplendent.”
18.asv: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown flourish.
